summary: The framed result concerns finite simple four-uniform families and three distinct petals with an empty core allowed. The printed expanded implication matches those conventions, and the printed independent-two-star root has no I(27), support-size, or coordinate-enumeration hypothesis. The contribution boundary is appropriately the two actual-family exclusions relative to the inherited structural results; priority remains bounded by the disclosed search. One notation clarification would avoid the common maximum-versus-forcing-threshold ambiguity in f(4,3).

findings.statement: The manuscript defines G and I but uses f(4,3) without explicitly defining whether f is the maximum size of a sunflower-free family or the minimum size forcing a sunflower. The displayed 54 to 80 interval uses the former convention.
findings.disposition: Add one sentence defining f(4,3) as the maximum cardinality of a finite three-sunflower-free family of distinct four-element sets. This is an expository precision request, not an objection to the quantified theorem.

findings.statement: The degree-twenty link classification, at-most-two-high-point theorem, I(27) to G(81), and boundary reduction are explicitly inherited; only the actual A/B exclusions and their structural lemmas are claimed as present contributions.
findings.disposition: Retain this boundary and the explicit external-I(27) distinction in all final formats.

checks.method: Compared Section 1 with the frozen literal_intersecting_twenty_seven_implies_eighty source, including the finite-subfamily cardinality and pairwise-intersection quantifiers.
checks.observation: The source requires every family member to have cardinality exactly four and forbids a three-element subfamily with a common pairwise intersection; Finset eliminates repetitions and the existential core has no nonemptiness hypothesis. This matches the prose, including empty-core sunflowers.

checks.scope: Unconditional structural statement versus conditional global statement
checks.method: Read the printed independent_twenty_stars_card_le_eighty theorem in the frozen audit and the expanded terminal implication source.
checks.observation: The two-star statement quantifies over arbitrary Type u and needs only uniformity, sunflower-freeness, two distinct degree-twenty points, and their non-cooccurrence. The global terminal theorem retains the universally quantified intersecting bound as hI. No ground-set cutoff occurs in either conclusion.

checks.method: Compared the contribution statements with the frozen primary-source access ledger and the listed inherited premises; did not independently retrieve the external sources in this phase.
checks.observation: The manuscript claims improvement relative to the inspected 83 bound and inherited 81 corollary, while declining exhaustive priority. The ledger supports that bounded framing but cannot establish global novelty.
